proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b hab hc hm hg
  have himg : f '' Set.Icc a b = Set.Icc (f a) (f b) := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hm.monotoneOn (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hab) hx hx.1, hm.monotoneOn hx (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hab) hx.2⟩
    · exact intermediate_value_Icc hab hc
  rw [continuousOn_iff_isClosed]
  intro t ht
  refine ⟨f '' (t ∩ Set.Icc a b), ((isCompact_Icc.inter_left ht).image_of_continuousOn (hc.mono Set.inter_subset_right)).isClosed, ?_⟩
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    have hy3 := hy2
    rw [← himg] at hy3
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy3
    have hy4 : g (f x) ∈ t := hy1
    rw [hg x hx] at hy4
    exact ⟨⟨x, ⟨hy4, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hy2⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxt, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hy2⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hy2⟩
    show g (f x) ∈ t
    rw [hg x hx]
    exact hxt
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → StrictMonoOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, g (f x) = x) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc (f a) (f b))
